* '''Playtest''' ([[Dark Jedi Lightsaber (V) (Playtest)]], 12 July 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 12 July 2019: [[:File:V11-D-darkjedilightsaber-20190712.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/426f8e6/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/darkjedilightsaber.gif Holotable commit 426f8e6 “Jedi Lightsabers”]), no mark. Text: “Deploy on Aurra, Grievous, or your warrior of ability &gt; 4. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny &gt; defense value.”
* '''Original''' ([[Dark Jedi Lightsaber (V)]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-darkjedilightsaber-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/darkjedilightsaber.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: “Deploy on Aurra, Grievous, or your warrior of ability &gt; 4. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny &gt; defense value.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered for release with sharper graphics; same words (the lore still prints “Mutlifaceted”).
*: [[File:V11-D-darkjedilightsaber-20190802-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''

Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny &gt; defense value.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same game text; the lore misspelling “Mutlifaceted” became “Multifaceted”; re-rendered at high resolution.
